background: Suffolk Building Society is a small mutual based in Ipswich, funded by retail savings from its branches across Suffolk and lending on residential mortgages, including self-build, holiday-let and expatriate lending.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the society. The one figure held is CET1 of 13.3%, which is in the bottom quarter of UK building societies against the peer median, so on the one measure available the society carries less capital than most of its peers. No leverage or liquidity figures are held, and no trend can be drawn. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A small regional mutual whose single published ratio sits at the low end of the group, so any placement rests on the society's own accounts and the deposit guarantee.
